capabilities: Write meeting notes from a live transcript
Improve existing writing without a recording
disambiguation: Not a shorthand or stenography writing system; it records audio and has an AI backend write the notes.
extras: Desktop only; the plugin does not include Shorthand, an AI model, or a cloud service. Recordings, transcripts and agent sessions are deleted by default when a capture finishes. Free and open source, but main.js bundles the non-open-source Anthropic Claude Agent SDK.
problem: Turning a live meeting or spoken thoughts into a structured Obsidian note normally means transcribing and rewriting by hand.
